title: product-description-generated
description: Published by the AI service (not yet built) after generating a product description in response to a product-description-requested message. Consumed by backend (App\Services\Sqs\ProductDescriptionGeneratedConsumer, queue services.sqs.queues.product_description_generated) to write the description back onto the product. See docs/design.md. Lives under services/backend for the same reason as product-description-requested.schema.json — revisit sharing once the AI service exists.
